attributes.title: 2027 NASW National Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 NASW National Conference is scheduled for June 21 to 25, 2027, at the Oregon Convention Center in Portland. The theme is "Navigating Uncertainty. Strengthening Service. Influencing the Future." The Hyatt Regency Portland next to the convention center is the headquarters hotel.

The proposal review is still under way: NASW plans to send decisions on December 1, 2026. Registration rates, the number of social work CE contact hours and the session program are not published yet; NASW says rate information is coming soon.
